subject: Startups
subcategory: The Art of the Startup Pitch
title: The Problem Slide
description: A 60-second lesson on The Problem Slide.

hook.text: The most important slide in your deck isn't the solution—it's the problem. Investors fund pain, not cleverness.

buildup.text: A great problem slide makes the audience feel the pain. It uses data, stories, or examples that hit personally.

discovery.text: Uber's early pitch showed: 'Cab rides are expensive, unreliable, and you can't track your driver.' Everyone nodded.

twist.text: The biggest pitch fail: presenting a solution to a problem nobody has.

climax.text: Make the problem feel urgent and large. If the room doesn't think 'someone must fix this,' your solution won't matter.

punchline.text: Sell the pain first. The solution sells itself after.

quiz.question: Why is the problem slide considered the most important?
options: Investors fund real pain, not just clever solutions
It comes first in the deck
